slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain after a fall or jump

caption:
Toto's heel stings with the first steps out of bed. It eases after a few steps, then it's back the next morning.

The thick tissue under the foot, where it joins the heel, stiffens while you rest and pulls tight on that first step. It's common in runners and often follows a jump in activity, new shoes or tight calves.

Hybi's 1-minute heel care: a towel stretch before you get up, 20 seconds × 3, cushioned shoes even at home, and slow heel raises × 10 twice a day. Research suggests strength work plus load changes helps.

Pain after a fall, heel pain at night, swelling or tingling are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
